name: Katalist
title: katalist.ai
shortDescription: Katalist transforms scripts into visual storyboards, catering to filmmakers, advertisers, and content creators. It simplifies the process of visualizing story pitches and video ideas, turning detailed scripts into consistent and engaging storyboards. An example use case is a filmmaker using Katalist to quickly create storyboards for a new movie pitch, ensuring visual consistency and speeding up pre-production.
pros: Script to storyboard in one click
cons: May not support all script formats
